description: Election Commission - Filling of a Vacancy in the Office Member of the Naththandiya Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: The gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local government body (Naththandiya Pradesiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process triggered by a resignation and the subsequent nomination by a political party, culminating in the official declaration of a new member by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under electoral processes at the local government level, making it an **Elections Gazette**.
